test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FLUTE' is written as 'VGFOU' and 'EXILE' is written as 'VORCV'. How will 'BLOOD' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

The corresponding of alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f91d0cf2227ca243511cf2dad8508dd6174723daa7acbf2a53a6f9c5848b2bc.png] 

The logic here is:

First we need to start writing the given word from right to left and then see the corresponding of each letter is the code language.

For the word FLUTE, reverse is ETULF then it is written as VGFOU:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc1fa7cb20a2010dc75ecbaf90a49f61b8379ccd478d87ee3865a87785398a03.png] 

For the word EXILE, the reverse is ELIXE then it is written as VORCV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bc7ae08ffd531dbda7c2225f1c439ea202e88804fda35c71ef6cde9529be33c.png] 

Similarly, for the word BLOOD, the reveres is DOOLB then it is written as WLLOY.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed1dcc8b6cbc36bd402c31e7391cb1c3a414c4d94712b4c08bfc0a6e07fae999.png] 

Hence, the given word can be written as '__**WLLOY**__'.
